adjudication_item: task (4): align the openssh-server L4 atlas row the way openssh was aligned (same recipe flags), re-measure only that family, and state whether its digest matches the analysed sshd.

recipe_alignment.mechanism: _RECIPE_OVERRIDES['openssh-server'] (table seam; no code special-cases the family)

measurement.body_hash_note: recomputed by the freeze generator from the body and reproduced

durable_identity.reused_rows_carry: reused_from_candidate_identity marker when the committed row was measured against a different install
durable_identity.statement: the row was re-measured against the freeze's install, not reused; its candidate identity is the freeze's libcrypto

remaining_difference.statement: The recipe flags are now the same as the openssh row and the closure: same configure flags, full make, candidate lib on the run path, same archive, same recipe/source. The only remaining difference is the build root and the compiled-in prefix. The atlas row configures with {scratch}/openssh-server/candidate/src/openssh-9.9p1/.l7-install (and that prefix's sysconfdir/privsep path), while the analysed sshd was built by forensics/tools/build_openssh_closure.sh under court/tmp/openssh-closure/server-b85/install. Those path strings are compiled into sshd (config paths, SSHD_SESSION), so the two binaries cannot be byte-equal even from identical flags.
remaining_difference.not_a_build_failure: the difference is the declared build-root difference; the recipe, archive, toolchain, candidate libcrypto and full-make intent are identical

non_claims: does not claim the atlas row measured the analysed sshd
does not re-analyse or re-link either binary
does not change any closure count, verdict or refusal
